title: Seeing small numbers at a glance without counting
examples: How can I see how many without counting?
How do I know it is seven without counting?

explain.say: Quick! How many dots? You probably knew without counting. Your eyes can see small amounts in a flash. This is called subitising, which means seeing how many at a glance.

draw.text: Seeing small numbers at a glance without counting

explain.say: Now there are four. Did you need to count them one by one? Your eyes just know! Can you show me four fingers just as fast?
Here is five. Look: one whole row of the frame is full up. A full row is always five. So when you see a full row, you know it is five without counting. Can you clap five times?
Now seven. Do not count every dot! See the full row of five, then two more. Five and two make seven. Can you see the five hiding inside?
Nine: a full row of five, and four more. It is also one less than a full frame of ten! Fantastic seeing! Challenge: roll a dice and say the number before you count the dots.

faq.a: Subitising means knowing how many things there are just by looking, without counting one by one. Most people can do it for up to about four things.

faq.q: How do I see bigger numbers quickly?
faq.a: Look for small groups inside. Seven can be a row of five and two more. Your eyes put the groups together.
asks: How do I see seven fast?

faq.q: Why does a full row help?
faq.a: A ten frame row holds five. When you see a full row, you know it is five, so you only need to look at the extra dots.
asks: Tell me about the ten frame

faq.a: Dice games, dominoes and dot cards are perfect. Say the number before you count, then check.

faq.q: What if I still need to count?
faq.a: That is fine! Counting is a great skill too. With practice, your eyes will spot more amounts in a flash. A teacher or grown-up can play quick-look games with you.

facts: Most people can tell up to about four objects at a glance without counting.
A ten frame has two rows of five spaces, so it holds ten counters.

quiz.say: A full row of a ten frame holds how many?
quiz.show: A full row of a ten frame holds…
quiz.why: Each row of a ten frame holds five.

wrong.0: Four is one less than a full row.
wrong.2: Ten fills the whole frame: two rows of five.

quiz.say: A full row of five and two more makes how many?

wrong.0: Six is five and one more.
wrong.2: Eight is five and three more.
